telemetry.title: Help balance the game?
telemetry.intro: You can choose to share gameplay statistics so we can see which heroes, items and synergies need changes.
telemetry.data: We send only newly finished matches: mode, AI / duel / trial, difficulty, balance version, outcome and ending reason, rounds, MMR band, gold earned, towers destroyed, your heroes, stars, items, synergies, damage, healing, kills and deaths. We also include your boards and results for each round.
telemetry.identity: Matches use a random analytics identifier to calculate player win rates. This is a pseudonym, not complete anonymity. We do not send your name, email, account ID, registration date, messages, photo or opponent's boards to PostHog. We do not track clicks or record your screen; location enrichment is disabled.
telemetry.provider: Statistics go to PostHog Cloud in the US region. The game team and PostHog have access to them.
telemetry.choice: Declining does not affect gameplay, ratings or saves. Change your choice in settings or your profile at any time. Closing this window does not give consent.
telemetry.retention: Events are retained while consent is active, within the PostHog project's retention period. Turning telemetry off or deleting your account stops collection and queues previously sent events for deletion. Deletion is processed asynchronously, not immediately.
telemetry.cloud: Cloud saves and the data needed for duels and friends operate separately. Your old match history is not sent to analytics.
telemetry.agree: I allow the described gameplay statistics to be sent to PostHog for balance analysis
telemetry.error: Could not save your choice. Telemetry on this device is paused. Check your connection and try again; the server changes only after a successful save.
telemetry.on: Sharing statistics with PostHog is allowed
telemetry.unavailable: Could not check consent. Statistics are not being sent.

start.lede: You are the coach. Draft a team of up to five heroes, send them down the lanes and watch the match play itself. Break the enemy throne before they break yours.

steps.shop: Buy heroes in the shop. Three copies of a hero merge into one with an extra star.
steps.lanes: Drag heroes to top, mid and bot. Synergies only work between heroes on the same lane.
steps.fight: Press Fight and watch the lanes push. Damage to towers and the throne carries over for the rest of the match.
steps.grow: Save gold, buy experience and items: every level lets one more hero onto the map.

welcome.title: Welcome, coach
welcome.text: A few quick steps to show you around. Close the tour with the cross and reopen it any time from the menu.

board.title: The map
board.threeLanes: Three lanes: top, mid and bot. Your base is bottom left, the enemy base is top right. Each lane has a tower with the throne behind them. Destroy the enemy throne to win.
board.twoLanes: Two lanes: top and bot, with the jungle between them. Your base is on the left, the enemy base on the right. Each lane has a tower with the throne behind them. Destroy the enemy throne to win.
board.oneLane: One lane: a long bridge. Your base is bottom left, the enemy base is top right. Each side has two towers on the bridge, and heal relics wait in the middle. A round goes to building damage and kills.

shop.title: Hero shop
shop.text: Click a card to buy the hero. The price is in the top right corner. When a card shows “★★ on buy”, buying it upgrades your hero right away.

economy.title: Gold and level
economy.text: Reroll gives new cards for 2 gold. XP raises your team level: each level lets one more hero onto the map.

bench.title: Heroes
bench.text: Heroes you buy land here. Drag them straight onto a lane on the map.

place.title: Placing heroes
place.text: Drag a hero onto a lane, or click the hero and then the lane. Heroes on the same lane give each other synergies.

tracker.title: Lanes
tracker.text: Each lane shows your heroes against the enemy’s and which synergies are active on both sides. Dashed badges show who you need for the next synergy. An empty lane is a gift to the enemy.

items.title: Items
items.text: The Items tab sells upgrades. Click a bought item in the stash, then a hero, or just drag it: every hero has two slots. The item card also lets you sell it.

scoreboard.title: Score
scoreboard.text: Health of both sides' towers and thrones. Structure damage carries over between rounds.

fight.title: Fight
fight.text: When your team is ready, press Fight. The battle plays itself; you can speed it up or skip it. Good luck!

modes.title: Three modes
modes.text: You are learning on two lanes. There is also the classic three lanes and a quick fight on one, across a bridge. Pick the mode when you start a match; each has its own duel rating.

difficultyHint.relaxed: No timer: the battle starts when you press Fight.
